module: Mission unlock condition types based on the progress of other missions: missionPassed (passed) and missionCompleted (completed). They read mission.saveData.progress[key].aggregate. The progress key can be 'default' (or empty), 'any' (any of them) or a specific key.
notes: If the referenced mission does not exist, an error log is emitted and the condition is false.
The local function F is not exported: checkAggregateWithKey and getTargetLabel are not accessible from outside.
The missionFunction block is commented out in the code (inactive).

missionPassed.desc: Condition {type='missionPassed', missionId, progressKey}: true if aggregate.passed is true. editorFunction 'displayMissionCondition'.

missionCompleted.desc: Condition {type='missionCompleted', missionId, progressKey}: true if aggregate.completed is true. editorFunction 'displayMissionConditionWithProgressKey'.

F.desc: Local helper table (not exported) used by missionPassed and missionCompleted.

checkAggregateWithKey.desc: Checks whether, for the given mission, at least one of the progress keys has the aggregate[field] field true.

progressKey.desc: 'default'/nil/'' = defaultProgressKey, 'any' = all keys, otherwise a specific key.

field.desc: Field of aggregate to test (passed, completed...).

returns.desc: true if a key satisfies the field.
